props.footer: Ndede has already used his {@spell dominate} spell today to maintain his control of Arodeth's bodyguard, {@creature Raflin Dorrum|SF1|Raflin}.

mid.name: Capture Magic
mid.trigger: The Blade magi succeeds at a save against a foe's harmful spell, or a foe fails a spell attack roll against the Blade magi with a harmful spell
entries: The Blade magi enters their {@action Arcane Cascade|SoM}. If the Blade magi is already in {@action Arcane Cascade|SoM}, they gain a +2 status bonus to damage from {@action Arcane Cascade|SoM} until the end of their next turn.

bot.name: Arcane Cascade
bot.requirements: The Blade magi can enter this stance if their most recent action was to {@action Cast a Spell} or make a {@action Spellstrike|SoM}, but the Blade magi can remain in the stance even if they no longer meet the requirements
entries: When the Blade magi enters this stance and at the beginning of each of their turns while in it, the Blade magi gains 5 temporary Hit Points. While in this stance, the Blade magi's melee {@action Strike||Strikes} gain the {@trait arcane} trait, deal an extra 2 force damage, and deal 4 {@trait splash} force damage to foes adjacent to the target.

bot.name: Spellstrike
entries: The Blade magi channels a spell into a melee {@action Strike} to deliver a magically charged attack. The Blade magi casts {@spell acid splash}, {@spell ray of frost}, or {@spell vampiric touch}. The effects of the spell don't occur immediately but are imbued into the Blade magi's attack instead. The Blade magi makes a melee {@action Strike}, which gains the {@trait arcane} trait. The spell is coupled with the attack, using the Blade magi's attack roll to determine the effects of both the {@action Strike} and the spell. This counts as two attacks for their multiple attack penalty, but the penalty isn't applied until after the magus has completed the {@action Spellstrike|SoM}.

After using {@action Spellstrike|SoM}, the Blade magi can't do so again until they recharge this ability as a single action, which has the {@trait concentrate} trait. The Blade magi also recharges their {@action Spellstrike|SoM} when they cast {@spell thunderous strike|SoM}.

bot.name: Captivating Song
entries: As {@creature harpy}, but DC 33.

bot.name: Dread Cry
entries: Queen Kawlinawk utters a screech in a 60-foot cone that harms her enemies but heartens her allies. The screech deals {@damage 14d6} sonic damage to non-harpy creatures in the area (DC 33 basic Fortitude save). Harpies in the area can instead use a reaction to {@action Fly}, {@action Step}, or {@action Stride}; one harpy in the area, of Queen Kawlinawk's choice, can instead use a reaction to {@action Strike}. Queen Kawlinawk can't use Dread Cry for {@dice 1d4} rounds.

bot.name: War Formation
entries: Queen Kawlinawk deals an extra {@dice 2d6} damage with her melee {@action Strike||Strikes} to any creature that's within reach of at least one of her allies.

bot.name: Captivating Song
entries: As {@creature harpy}, but DC 29.

bot.name: War Formation
entries: A harpy warbird deals an extra {@dice 2d6} damage with its melee {@action Strike||Strikes} to any creature that's within reach of at least one of the harpy's allies.

mid.name: Juggernaut When
entries: Endlo rolls a success at a Fortitude save, he gets a critical success instead.

bot.name: Gorum's Hand
entries: Endlo deals an additional die of damage with greatswords (included in his {@action Strike} above), which also adds an additional die to his {@spell weapon storm} spell.

bot.name: Replenishment of War When
entries: Endlo damages a creature with a greatsword {@action Strike}, he gains 6 temporary Hit Points until the start of his next turn. If the {@action Strike} was a critical hit, he instead gains 12 temporary Hit Points.

bot.name: Resolute Stance
entries: Endlo draws upon the might of stone to bolster his defenses. While in this stance, he gains a +2 status bonus to his AC and increases his resistance to slashing damage to 15, but he reduces his Speeds by 5 feet.

mid.name: Bravery
entries: When the mercenary rolls a successful Will save against a {@trait fear} effect, they get a critical success instead. When the mercenary gains the {@condition frightened} condition, reduce its value by 1.

bot.name: Cat Fall
entries: The mercenary treats falls as 25 feet shorter.

bot.name: Power Attack
entries: The mercenary makes a melee {@action Strike}. This counts as two attacks when calculating the mercenary's multiple attack penalty. If this {@action Strike} hits, the mercenary deals an extra die of weapon damage.

bot.name: Ready Armaments
entries: The mercenary {@action Interact||Interacts} to draw or stow a weapon, then {@action Interact||Interacts} to draw or stow a weapon. The mercenary can instead {@action Raise a Shield} instead of either {@action Interact} action.

bot.name: Hunt Prey
entries: Shaldar Falls-Far designates a single creature she can see and hear, or one that she's Tracking, as her prey. She gains a +2 circumstance bonus to {@skill Perception} checks to {@action Seek} the prey and to {@skill Survival} checks to {@action Track} the prey. The first time she hits the designated prey in a round, she deals an additional {@damage 1d8} precision damage. She also ignores the penalty for making ranged attacks within her second range increment. These effects last until Shaldar Falls-Far uses {@action Hunt Prey} again.

bot.name: Hunter's Aim
entries: Shaldar Falls-Far makes a ranged weapon {@action Strike} against her hunted prey. On this {@action Strike}, she gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignores the prey's {@condition concealed} condition.

creature.name: Kannijo
creature.description: Male {@creature spirit naga|B2} {@creatureTemplate vampire, jiang-shi|BotD|jiangi-shi vampire}

attacks.name: fangs
attacks.damage: {@damage 3d10+10} piercing plus {@ability Grab} and spirit naga venom

top.name: Breathsense
entries: 60 feet (precise). As {@creatureTemplate vampire, jiang-shi|BotD|jiangi-shi}.

mid.name: Jiang-Shi Vulnerabilities
entries: As {@creatureTemplate vampire, jiang-shi|BotD|jiangi-shi}.

mid.name: One More Breath
entries: As {@creatureTemplate vampire, jiang-shi|BotD|jiangi-shi}.

mid.name: Harrowed Fulu
entries: Unlike the typical {@creatureTemplate vampire, jiang-shi|BotD|jiangi-shi}, Kannijo's warped fulu has been replaced by a card from the Deck of Destiny—a replacement that has largely gone {@condition unnoticed} by the vampire. Kannijo is immune to spells cast from a magic item without expending a spell slot, such as from a scroll or wand, and also gains the passive abilities granted from The Snakebite (but not its activation ability). A creature can {@action Steal} The Snakebite to remove it (DC 33). This immediately ends Kannijo's immunity to these effects, negates the card's passive effects, and removes Kannijo's fast healing. Kannijo can no longer use The Snakebite as its fulu, but can create a replacement warped fulu by spending 1 uninterrupted hour inscribing a strip of paper (or similar) with a writing instrument.

bot.name: Drain Qi
bot.requirements: A {@condition grabbed}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition restrained}, {@condition unconscious}, or willing creature is within Kannijo's reach
entries: As {@creatureTemplate vampire, jiang-shi|BotD|jiangi-shi}.

bot.name: Manipulate the Green
entries: Kannijo can use {@ritual inveigle} against {@trait plant} creatures normally immune to {@trait mental} effects, and can communicate with inveigled {@trait plant} creatures as if under the effects of {@spell speak with plants}.

bot.name: Rigor Mortis
entries: As {@creatureTemplate vampire, jiang-shi|BotD|jiangi-shi}.

spellcasting.footer: * Indicates a spell that was previously cast earlier in the day.

bot.name: Slough Toxins
entries: As nagaji.

creature.name: Arraseesh
creature.description: Nonbinary human {@creature captain of the guard|GMG}

creature.name: Zashuvin
items: ruby religious symbol of {@deity Pazuzu|LOGM} worth 750 gp

mid.name: Snap Shot
mid.requirements: Raskus holds a loaded {@item spike launcher|G&G}
mid.trigger: A creature within 30 feet of Raskus uses a {@trait move} action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a {@trait move} action it's using
entries: Raskus attempts a {@item spike launcher|G&G} {@action Strike} against the triggering creature. This {@action Strike} doesn't contribute to his multiple attack penalty, and his multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this {@action Strike}.

bot.name: Go for the Eyes
bot.trigger: Raskus critically hits with a beak {@action Strike}
entries: Raskus attempts to peck out his victim's eyes. The target must attempt a DC 29 Fortitude save.

Failure: The target is {@condition blinded} for 1 round.
Critical Failure: The target is {@condition blinded} until healed to its maximum Hit Points.

bot.name: Opportunistic Attack
entries: Raskus's {@action Strike||Strikes} deal an additional {@dice 3d6} damage to any foe that has a reduction to its Speed, is {@condition blinded}, or is {@condition immobilized}.

bot.name: Quick Spiker
entries: Raskus requires only 1 action, rather than 2 actions, to reload a {@item spike launcher|G&G}. He can change his grip on a {@item spike launcher|G&G} easily, improving its {@trait fatal aim <d12>} trait to {@trait fatal <d12>}. (These changes are incorporated into its ranged {@action Strike}, above.)

mid.name: Snap Shot
entries: As {@creature Raskus|SF1}.

bot.name: Go for the Eyes
entries: As {@creature Raskus|SF1}, but DC 26.

bot.name: Quick Spiker
entries: As {@creature Raskus|SF1}.

mid.name: Defensive Charm
mid.trigger: Vharnev is the target of a ranged attack
entries: Vharnev quickly traces a defensive rune between himself and the source of the ranged attack, giving him a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

bot.name: Sudden Charge
entries: Vharnev {@action Stride||Strides} twice and makes a melee {@action Strike}.

bot.name: Uniila Witch Token
entries: Vharnev bears the uniila's witch token in the form of an amulet with {@deity Mahathallah|LOGM|Mahathallah's} rune-ringed eye symbol. Vharnev's spells lower than 5th level count as 1 level higher for the purpose of being counteracted and counteracting other spells. Once per day, Vharnev can activate the token to cast {@spell confusion} (DC 29).

creature.name: Mercenary Assassin
items: simple injury poison (4 doses {@damage 2d4} poison damage)

top.name: Swift Sneak
entries: The assassin can move their full Speed while {@action Sneak||Sneaking}.

bot.name: Poison Weapon
bot.requirements: The assassin wields a piercing weapon and has a free hand
entries: The assassin applies a poison to the weapon.

bot.name: Sneak Attack
entries: The assassin deals an extra {@damage 2d6} precision damage to {@condition flat-footed} creatures.

mid.name: Extraneous Flesh
mid.trigger: A {@action Strike} scores a critical hit on the bhanyada scavenger
entries: A critical hit might simply sever a component chunk that the bhanyada can lose without much harm. The bhanyada scavenger attempts a DC {@flatDC 11} flat check. On a success, it doesn't take any extra damage from the critical hit (although it takes other effects normally, such as critical specialization effects).

mid.name: Odor of Rot
entries: 10 feet. Creatures other than aberrations that enter or start their turn in the bhanyada's aura must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude save or become {@condition sickened||sickened 1} ({@condition sickened||sickened 2} on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

bot.name: Change Posture
entries: The bhanyada changes between a bipedal and quadrupedal stance. In its bipedal stance, the bhanyada can't use Sudden Charge. In its quadrupedal stance, it loses its climb Speed.

bot.name: Gnashing Bite
entries: The bhanyada's teeth shift in its mouth as it bites. The bhanyada makes a jaws {@action Strike}. On a hit, the target takes an additional {@damage 2d10} bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition slowed||slowed 1} for 1 round if the {@action Strike} dealt bludgeoning damage, or takes {@damage 1d8} {@condition persistent damage||persistent bleed damage} if the {@action Strike} dealt piercing damage.

bot.name: Sudden Charge
entries: The bhanyada {@action Stride||Strides} twice and makes a jaws {@action Strike} at the end of its movement.

mid.name: Extraneous Flesh
entries: As {@creature bhanyada scavenger|SF1}.

mid.name: Odor of Rot
entries: As {@creature bhanyada scavenger|SF1}, but DC 27.

bot.name: Swarming Bites
entries: Each enemy in the bhanyada swarm's space takes {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save). On a failed save, a creature is also {@condition slowed||slowed 1} for 1 round.

mid.name: Extraneous Flesh
entries: As {@creature bhanyada scavenger|SF1}.

mid.name: Odor of Rot
entries: As {@creature bhanyada scavenger|SF1}, but DC 29.

bot.name: Lumbering Swings
entries: The bhanyada behemoth {@action Stride||Strides} and makes up to four fist {@action Strike||Strikes} at any point during that movement. Each {@action Strike} must target a different creature. The attacks take the normal multiple attack penalty.

abilities: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

attacks.name: claw
attacks.damage: {@damage 3d4+13} slashing plus {@damage 1d6} evil and ferrugon tetanus

spells.name: wall of stone
notes: wall is made of rusty iron, not stone

spells.name: flesh to stone
notes: target is transformed into rusty iron, not stone

mid.name: Metallic
entries: A ferrugon is a metallic creature and thus affected by effects such as {@spell rusting grasp|APG}.

mid.name: Vainglorious Whispers
mid.trigger: A non-devil creature within 30 feet of the ferrugon succeeds (but doesn't critically succeed) at an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw
entries: The ferrugon whispers subversive messages to the triggering creature, causing it to become overly confident in its abilities, while in fact it becomes less accomplished overall. The target must attempt a DC 32 Will save. On a failure, the target gains a +2 status bonus to saving throws against {@trait fear} effects but also takes a −2 penalty to all attack rolls and skill checks for 1 hour. During this time, the victim can't benefit from {@action Aid} reactions, use {@trait healing} effects on themselves, or use {@action Take Cover} or {@action Raise a Shield} actions, as these actions seem unnecessary to the creature at this time. Similar defensive actions might not be available to the victim as well, at the GM's discretion. The target is then temporarily immune to Vainglorious Whispers for 24 hours.

bot.name: Sunder Objects
entries: When a ferrugon damages an item or structure, they deal an additional {@dice 2d8} damage to that item or structure.

abilities: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

bot.name: Every Dagger
entries: The uniila attempts a single dagger {@action Strike} against a target. If this {@action Strike} hits, the uniila deals three extra dice of weapon damage.

bot.name: Fearsome Magic
entries: If the uniila's next action is to cast a harmful spell, creatures who fail their saving throw against the spell are {@condition frightened||frightened 1} ({@condition frightened||frightened 2} on a critical failure), in addition to the spell's other effects.

bot.name: Witch Token
entries: The uniila creates a token in the shape of a piece of jewelry. When the witch token is {@trait invested} by a mortal, all of the mortal's spells, except those cast at the highest level the mortal can cast, count as 1 level higher for the purpose of counteracting other spells and being counteracted. The creature can also {@action activate an item||Activate the witch token} to {@action Cast a Spell} once per day. This spell is chosen from one of the uniila's arcane spontaneous spells of level 4 or lower when the uniila creates the token. While a creature has the witch token {@trait invested}, it treats its saving throws against the uniila's spells as one degree of success worse, and the uniila always knows the distance and direction to the creature. A creature can't have more than one witch token {@trait invested}, and an uniila can't have more than one witch token in existence. The uniila can destroy their witch token as a free action with the {@trait concentrate} trait; if the witch token is {@trait invested} when the uniila does so, the creature that has the witch token {@trait invested} takes {@damage 9d8} mental damage (DC 29 basic Will save).

top.name: Lifesense
entries: A hurlilu senses the vital essence of living creatures within range.

mid.name: Dominate the Air
mid.trigger: A creature within 30 feet leaves the ground using a fly Speed
entries: The hurlilu casts {@spell earthbind} on the triggering creature.

bot.name: Dive Bomb
entries: The hurlilu {@action Stride||Strides} using its fly Speed and makes a {@action Strike} at the end of that movement.

bot.name: Flesh Tearer
entries: If a hurlilu critically hits a foe with a melee {@action Strike}, the foe's flat check to recover from any resulting {@condition persistent damage||bleed damage} is DC 19 instead of DC 15.

top.name: Soundsense
entries: An oppali's sense of hearing is a precise sense to a range of 60 feet.

mid.name: Energizing Incompetence
mid.trigger: A creature within 30 feet critically fails an attack against the oppali
entries: The attack instead becomes a failure, and the oppali becomes {@condition quickened||quickened 1} for 1 round. It can use this extra action to {@action Step}, {@action Stride}, or {@action Strike}.

bot.name: Drain Luck
entries: A creature other than an {@trait animal} or {@trait plant} hit by an oppali's vine {@action Strike} must attempt a DC 29 Fortitude saving throw twice, taking the lower result as the actual result.

Critical Success: The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Drain Luck for 24 hours.
Success: The creature takes {@damage 2d6} poison damage. Until the start of the creature's next turn, the creature must roll twice and take the worse result on all checks.
Failure: The creature takes {@damage 2d6} {@condition persistent damage||persistent poison damage}. For 1 round, the creature must roll twice and take the worse result on all checks.
Critical Failure: The creature takes {@damage 4d6} {@condition persistent damage||persistent poison damage}. For 1 minute, the creature must roll twice and take the worse result on all checks.

bot.name: Trumpet Blast
entries: The oppali emits a massive blast of discordant noise that deals {@damage 9d8} sonic damage to creatures within a 60-foot cone (DC 29 basic Fortitude save). Creatures who fail the save are also {@condition deafened} for 1 round. The oppali can't use its Trumpet Blast again for {@dice 1d4} rounds or until it takes at least 20 points of sonic damage from a single source (whichever comes first).

creature.name: Arodeth
items: spellbook (contains all prepared spells plus an additional {@dice 2d6} spells of the GM's choosing)

mid.name: Fated to Fail
mid.trigger: A creature adjacent to Arodeth rolls a hit or critical hit with a melee {@action Strike}
entries: Arodeth attempts a {@skill Lore||Fortune-Telling Lore} check against the triggering creature's Will DC. On a success, the attack is reduced by one degree of success (from a hit to a miss, or a critical hit to a hit).

bot.name: Arcane Cascade
entries: Lady Arodeth can enter this stance only if her most recent action was to {@action Cast a Spell} or make a {@action Spellstrike|SoM}, but she can remain in the stance even if she no longer meets the requirements Effect While in this stance, Arodeth can {@action Interact} or {@action Release} to change her grip on her staff as a free action when she {@action Strike||Strikes} with the staff, including {@action Strike||Strikes} made in a {@action Spellstrike|SoM}. This happens before she rolls her attack roll. She can also {@action Interact} to change her grip on the staff as a free action triggered at the end of her turn.

bot.name: Spellstrike
entries: Arodeth channels a spell into a melee {@action Strike} to deliver a charged attack. She casts {@spell chill touch}, {@spell disintegrate}, or {@spell produce flame}. The effects of the spell don't occur immediately but are imbued into her attack instead. Arodeth makes a staff {@action Strike}, which gains the {@trait arcane} trait. The spell is coupled with the attack, using Arodeth's attack roll to determine the effects of both the {@action Strike} and the spell. This counts as two attacks for her multiple attack penalty, but the penalty isn't applied until after she has completed the {@action Spellstrike|SoM}. After using {@action Spellstrike|SoM}, she can't do so again until she recharges this ability as a single action, which has the {@trait concentrate} trait. She also recharges her {@action Spellstrike|SoM} when she casts {@spell runic impression|SoM} or {@spell spinning staff|SoM}.

bot.name: Twisting Tree
entries: As {@subclassFeature Hybrid Study|Magus|SoM|Twisting Tree|SoM|1||magus}. Arodeth's unique fighting style also allows her to add the {@trait finesse} trait to any staff she wields in combat.

attacks.name: bastard sword
attacks.damage: {@damage 3d8+11} slashing plus {@damage 1d6} {@condition persistent damage||persistent bleed} and {@damage 1d6} fire

mid.name: Iron Command
mid.trigger: An enemy within 15 feet damages Drustan
entries: Drustan commands the triggering enemy to kneel before him in obedience. If they dare to refuse, they must pay the price in pain and anguish. The triggering enemy and each other enemy within 15 feet of Drustan must choose one of the following options.

items: The enemy kneels, dropping {@condition prone} as a free action.
The enemy refuses, and Drustan deals 4 mental damage to the enemy (the triggering enemy instead takes {@damage 4d6} mental damage and 5 {@condition persistent damage||persistent evil damage}).

entries: Drustan also deals an additional 2 evil damage with his {@action Strike||Strikes} against the triggering enemy until the end of Drustan's next turn.

bot.name: Divine Ally
entries: Drustan's divine ally is his bastard sword. He gains its critical specialization effect, and the weapon gains the {@item flaming} property rune.

bot.name: Smite Good
entries: Drustan selects one enemy he can see. Until the start of his next turn, his bastard sword {@action Strike||Strikes} against that foe deal an additional 6 evil damage. If the chosen enemy attacks Drustan before the start of his next turn, the duration extends to the end of that enemy's next turn.
